note: Bike setup (Spec 8.0 to 8.2; Boss, 31 Oct 2026: the Basic view arrives in Area 2, the Advanced view in Area 5). Five sliders, each over a group of part slots, from -1 (low) to +1 (high). A slider is locked at the default (0) until one part in its group is Grade unlockGrade or better. Positions per slider follow Mechanical Engineer level (positions: from that level, n positions spread evenly from -1 to +1). Every section type belongs to a kind in sectionKinds, and each kind has a hidden ideal per slider; a section type not listed is unaffected. In rain (weather time factor above 1) each ideal is averaged with the wet kind's. effect: tuning% = scale * (base - distance^2 * k), clamped to min..max, for each slider; a rider's gain on a section is the sum over the sliders of (their effect - the default's), so the default setup and every CPU rider are unchanged. presets (the Basic view) set each unlocked slider to presetShare of the mean ideal of the kinds it aims at (Round 121, 5B: about 80% of the best).
